svg.title: Fabric CI/CD design: branches, pipeline, workspaces and variable library value sets
svg.text: Fabric CI/CD design: branches, pipeline, workspaces and variable library value sets
Only Dev is connected to Git. UAT and Prod are deployed from their branch by fabric-cicd in one Azure Pipeline.
Changes arrive by PR from dev
A merge triggers the UAT deployment
Changes arrive by PR from uat
A merge triggers the Prod deployment
Only the Dev workspace is connected to Git
Developers build and test in Dev
Commit sends item definitions to the dev branch
MICROSOFT FABRIC · one workspace per environment, each with its own lakehouse and SQL database
Active value set: Default value set
Items read Dev IDs from the active value set
Items read UAT IDs from the active value set
Items read Prod IDs from the active value set
Naming rule: branch name = --environment passed to fabric-cicd = value set name (uat, prod) — exact and case-sensitive
Azure icons from Azure_Icons: Branch, Azure DevOps, App Registrations, SQL Database, Data Factories. Fabric has no icon in that set; Fabric items use custom glyphs.
